author: Progressor II
title: Run Consensus v2.7 Diagnostics for Phantom Sim Data
abstract: This script executes the 'diagnostics' command from shared/consensus_v1_5/cli.py to generate diagnostic outputs (per-run CSV, histograms, outliers) for existing phantom simulation data. This will help in understanding the baseline behavior of consensus metrics and identifying potential areas for novelty detection based on deviations or emergent patterns.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os

# Add the consensus_v1_5 directory to the Python path
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v1_5')

# Import the main function from cli.py and run the diagnostics subcommand
from cli import main as cli_main

print("Executing Consensus v2.7 Diagnostics...")

# Simulate command-line arguments for the diagnostics subcommand
# Using default eta=0.10, bins=20 as per diagnostics_v2_7.py
# No weights specified, so DEFAULT_WEIGHTS from aggregate_v2_7 will be used.
cli_main(argv=['diagnostics'])

print("\nConsensus v2.7 Diagnostics execution initiated. Outputs will be in storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7/diagnostics/.")
